name: limitguard
description: Trust Intelligence API for EU business entities over MCP: entity screening with sanctions checks, and risk scoring. REST is pure x402 pay-per-call with no signup. MCP needs a Bearer API key (free to create at POST /v1/keys/create); the free and sandbox tiers then pay per call with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1), paid tiers are covered by their subscription.

auth.rest: x402 pay-per-call, no API key, no signup
auth.mcp: Authorization: Bearer <key>; create one free at POST https://api.limitguard.ai/v1/keys/create, which returns an lg_live_ key on the default free tier and an lg_sandbox_ key when the body asks for "tier": "sandbox". Both authenticate, though the server's own error text names only lg_live_. Free and sandbox tiers also send PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT per call; paid tiers (indie and up) need no per-call payment

pricing.note: Networks mirror payment.chains in the x402 manifest, which names these two mainnets and sets testnet_supported without naming a testnet chain. Prices below mirror mcp_server/tier.py in limitguard-ai as of 2026-09-07. The x402 manifest is authoritative; fetch it for current values.

tools.name: check_entity
tools.description: Full trust intelligence check on a business entity. Returns trust score (0-100), risk level, and recommendation.

tools.name: get_risk_score
tools.description: Quick risk assessment without full trust check. Focuses on risk signals only.
